marginalia_corrections.original: Three fifeties ſignifie Penance. Mercie vvith iuſtice, and Praiſes of God.
marginalia_corrections.corrected: Three fifeties ſignifie Penance, Mercie vvith iuſtice, and Praiſes of God.

apparatus_corrections.original: Man created of corruptible bodie and immortal ſoule, is finally admoniſhed to praiſe our Lord, ouer and aboue the praiſes of al other corporal creatures; vvho alſo is more eſpecially bond therto then Angels, becauſe God hath voutſaffed to make himſelfe Man, to redeme man that vvas loſt by ſinne, and to endevv him vvith nevv grace, and ſo bring him to euerlaſting glorie, vvhere vvith holie Angels, men alſo for euer & euer ſhal praiſe our Lord, vvith hart, voice, and iubilation of ſpirite, ſinging as the Pſalmiſt concludeth, Alleluia.
apparatus_corrections.corrected: Man created of corruptible bodie and immortal ſoule, is finally admoniſhed to praiſe our Lord, ouer and aboue the praiſes of al other corporal creatures; vvho alſo is more eſpecially bond therto then Angels, becauſe God hath voutſaffed to make himſelfe Man, to redeme man that vvas loſt by ſinne, and to endew him vvith nevv grace, and ſo bring him to euerlaſting glorie, vvhere vvith holie Angels, men alſo for euer & euer ſhal praiſe our Lord, vvith hart, voice, and iubilation of ſpirite, ſinging as the Pſalmiſt concludeth, Alleluia.
